notes: 0.3.51：同步范围扩到「插件数据 + 额外路径」两组。以前只有固定白名单，新装的第三方插件写在自己目录里的配置和数据（redteam\knowledge.db、our-free-model\settings.json、dsh-purge、channel-pack 等）一律同步不上。现在：① 插件数据组自动枚举 DSH 一级目录，一个目录一个槽（跳过 profiles/skills/storages/dsh-runtimes 等已有专属组的目录与隐藏目录、node_modules）；② 额外路径组由你在面板里自己加绝对路径（目录或单文件）；③ 排除名单默认 50 条（数据库/二进制/压缩包/缓存/令牌/密钥等），一行一条、整份替换，单文件上限硬顶 100MB（GitHub 单文件限制），超了直接跳过。文本在仓库里用 {{APP_ROOT}} / {{DSH_HOME}} 等占位符，换机 apply 自动展开；二进制字节保真；写回前把目标侧旧文件先备份到 backups\config-<时间戳>。规则落在本机 ~\.dsh\config-sync-extra.json（不进仓库），面板新增「插件数据与额外路径」卡可直接改排除名单、上限与路径。
notesEn: 0.3.51 extends the sync scope to two new groups: "Plugin data" and "Extra paths". Until now only a fixed whitelist was synced, so configs and data that newly installed third-party plugins keep in their own folders (redteam\knowledge.db, our-free-model\settings.json, dsh-purge, channel-pack, ...) never travelled across machines. Now: (1) plugin data auto-enumerates the top-level folders of the DSH home, one folder per slot, skipping folders that already have a dedicated group (profiles/skills/storages/dsh-runtimes ...), hidden folders and node_modules; (2) extra paths are absolute paths you add in the panel, folder or single file; (3) the exclusion list ships with 50 wildcard entries (databases, binaries, archives, caches, tokens, keys ...), one per line, replaced wholesale, with a per-file cap hard-clamped to 100MB (GitHub single-file limit) — bigger files are skipped. Text files are stored with {{APP_ROOT}} / {{DSH_HOME}} placeholders and expanded on the other machine; binaries are copied byte for byte; overwritten target files are backed up into backups\config-<timestamp> first. Rules live in ~\.dsh\config-sync-extra.json (this machine only, never committed) and the new "Plugin data & extra paths" card edits the exclusions, the size cap and the path list.
